title: What are the main barriers to technology adoption?
content: Main barriers include organizational resistance to change, lack of training and support, budget constraints, and integration challenges.

title: How long does technology adoption typically take?
content: Timeline varies based on technology complexity and organizational readiness. Typically ranges from 3 months to 2 years.

title: What strategies help overcome adoption barriers?
content: Effective strategies include executive sponsorship, change management programs, user training, clear communication, and addressing specific barriers.
